goals: Preserve the accepted server-authoritative same-column radial selector for physical hotbar and ordinary inventory slots, including exact whole-stack swaps and selectable empty storage cells.
Keep HOLD as the accepted interaction mode, leave the artifact key unbound by default, preserve M as external Workbench configuration, and retain upstream Slot Cycler as replaced and disabled.
Maintain the exact private Traveler Tool Belt visual relationship without importing Traveler gameplay, storage, networking, code, or protected resource bytes into the public repository.
scope: Maintain the resource-clean Private Canary 2 source, Canary 1 behavior-parity fixtures, dynamic nine-wide ordinary-inventory mapping, three-integer server request, live menu and snapshot validation, and project-owned fallback wheel.
Retain the legally safe private assembler and verifier that require the exact user-owned Traveler input and allow only its one hash-pinned radial PNG to be injected into an ignored local artifact.
Retain exact clean Canary 1 as the distributable focused-runtime-pass rollback while recording the absent Private Canary 2 as current and accepted metadata only.

exclusions: The protected Traveler Tool Belt radial texture and radial-slot-cycler-0.1.0-canary2-private.jar are private, non-redistributable, ignored local inputs or outputs and are not tracked in this repository.
Traveler Tool Belt, Inventory Extended, and Slot Cycler source and artifacts remain separate owners and are not modified, bundled, routed through, or replaced by copied code.
Inventory routing, passive acquisition, quick move, merging, consolidation, Quick Stack Nearby, Stack to Nearby Chests, resource packs, and unrelated project behavior are outside scope.
Runtime deployment, Test Slot or accepted-baseline mutation, Test Instance Manager state, either gameplay profile, originals, and the protected gameplay instance are outside this migration.
Individual legacy checklist results, upstream Slot Cycler coexistence, optional toggle-mode acceptance, and dedicated-server validation are not inferred from the aggregate runtime evidence.

dependencies.reason: Target game version for the accepted server-authoritative selector.
Fabric loader floor declared by both retained canaries.
Provides the networking, client input, and HUD APIs used by the implementation.
The accepted Workbench configuration exposes six ordinary storage rows and seven radial entries without coupling to Inventory Extended source.
Exact separate accepted mod and user-owned origin of the one private 4,580-byte radial PNG; no Traveler code or tracked asset is imported.
Radial Slot Cycler is the accepted replacement; coexistence is not an acceptance requirement.
Minecraft 26.2 and the retained source compile and test against Java 25.
Exact build toolchain used for the controlled migration verification and historical private assembly base.

state.milestone: Private Canary 2 is the current and accepted private Workbench release after the user's aggregate focused runtime PASS; clean distributable Canary 1 remains the focused-runtime-pass rollback, and no individual checklist row is inferred.

current.summary: Provides a server-authoritative same-column radial selector for hotbar and inventory slots.

accepted.summary: Provides a server-authoritative same-column radial selector for hotbar and inventory slots.
